comment: The WEEKLY CHALLENGE (port ADR-109, PORT-159): one a week, the Nth for ISO week N (round the list). goal: WIN (win the match), MARGIN (win by n or more), SHUTOUT (win, they score at most n), ACES (n aces and the win), RALLY (a rally of n hits and the win). The score: the margin times 100, plus 50 an ace and 10 a hit of the longest rally; 0 unless the goal is met.

list.name: MOON BALL MONDAY
text: BEAT THE PIRATES BY 3 OR MORE.

list.name: GHOST STORY
text: BEAT THE GOTH CLUB IN DOUBLES.

list.name: ICE TIME
text: BEAT THE SNOWBIRDS BY 2 OR MORE.

list.name: THE LONG RALLY
text: WIN WITH A RALLY OF 12 HITS.

list.name: CLEAN SHEET
text: WIN, LETTING IN 1 POINT AT MOST.
